title: Canary Playtest & KPI Lighthouse — Go/No-Go Workbook
summary: Working workbook for a phased canary + playtest approach to validate rollout KPIs (latency, cost per request, error rate, quality regression) across host/dedicated/private deployments. Includes simulated traffic profiles, lightweight analysis heuristics for go/no-go, and a condensed checklist for on-call and product owners.
objectives: Simulate production traffic with 3 load profiles (low, baseline, spike)
Measure per-route latency P50/P95/P99 and cost/token across model variants
Detect quality regressions using canary eval prompt set
Provide deterministic go/no-go rules for phased rollouts
kpi_definitions: Latency_ms: observed median and tail latencies for 90s windows
Cost_per_1k_requests: estimate including GPU vs fallback routing
Error_rate_pct: client-facing 4xx/5xx and internal inference failures
Quality_regression_score: percent of prompts with degraded rating >= threshold
traffic_profiles: baseline: 300 rps sustained, diurnal pattern replay (observed week)
spike: 2k rps short 2-minute spike, 10% of baseline routed to canary
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Preflight: dry run on staging, smoke tests, eval pass
Phase 1 - Micro-canary: 0.1% traffic, 1 hour, strict KPI gating
Phase 2 - Small canary: 1% traffic, 6 hours, observational metrics + user metrics
Phase 3 - Ramp: 5%-25% traffic increments hourly with rollback windows
Phase 4 - Full: 100% with post-rollout monitoring and fallback ready
readiness_checklist: Ownership: product owner and SRE on-call assigned
Testing: canary eval prompt set uploaded and baseline scores recorded
Infra: autoscaling and burst capacity configured
Routing: traffic split config and fallback routes validated
Observability: dashboards (latency, errors, cost) pinned and alerting live
Fallback: model variant and region fallback tested end-to-end
Compliance: audit logging enabled for private deployments
Comm: stakeholder channel and update cadence scheduled
playtest_steps: 1) Deploy canary artifact with feature flag off
2) Run synthetic baseline traffic for 30m and capture metrics
4) If green, step to 1% for 6h; run quality eval hourly
5) If amber, pause and run mitigation checklist; if red, rollback immediately
canary_eval_plan: Eval set: 120 prompts across core intents (summarization, code-gen, instruction-following)
Metric: pairwise quality score (baseline vs canary) and acceptability threshold
Tooling: use optimize/eval harness and store results with commit id
Gate: fail if >3% prompts drop below acceptability or mean drop >0.5 points
alerting_and_escalation: Primary alert: latency/error breach to SRE on-call
Secondary: product owner notified for quality regressions
Escalation window: immediate for red, 30 min for amber
Communication: update #launch-ops and send summary to execs if phase change
contingency_plans: Auto-rollback: if P95 > 2x baseline or error_rate > 3% for 5m
Fallback model routing: shift canary traffic to smaller quantized variant
Region failover: reroute to secondary region with warm pool
Manual rollback: product owner + SRE authorization and postmortem template
observability_tips: Instrument token-level cost in traces to identify hot routes
Enable KV cache heatmap to detect cache thrashing during spike
Use sampling on slow tokens to collect full request payloads
Correlate prompt families to latency/cost to prioritize optimizations
decision_rules: Green: all KPIs green for 3 consecutive windows -> advance phase
Amber: single amber -> extend observation + mitigations; repeated amber -> rollback
Red: any red -> immediate rollback and incident declaration
Quality-first override: if quality gate fails, block rollout regardless of infra KPIs
responsibilities: Product ops: coordinate the playtest and update runway
SRE/Infra: validate autoscaling, routing, rollback paths
Applied ML: approve model variant and evaluate quality metrics
Dev rel/Docs: prepare user-facing notes if change is visible
open_questions_and_risks: Impact of caching changes on end-to-end user latency unclear
Quantized variant unknown regression patterns for code-gen prompts
Billing estimate for sustained 25% traffic not finalized
Dependency: Dedicated pool capacity reserve must be confirmed by infra by D-2
notes: This workbook is intentionally minimal and action-oriented. Use the eval harness links above for automated scoring. If staging results diverge from prod, increase the size of the canary eval prompt set and repeat. Capture any mitigation steps in the linked JIRA for future runbooks.
